description: List the most common conditions across active US clinical trials in a US state or city, with trial counts. Use this when the caller wants to see what is well-represented in a region before searching. Each entry carries the curated `slug` to pass to clinicaltrials_search_trials as `condition` (null when the label has no curated match - use clinicaltrials_list_conditions to find a close one). Counts come from AACT condition aggregations and refresh daily.

city.description: US city name. Allows letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes, and periods. Examples: "San Francisco", "St. Louis", "O'Fallon", "Wilkes-Barre". Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; maximum 100 characters.

limit.description: Maximum number of buckets to return from a top-N aggregation. Integer in [1, 25]. Default 10. Aggregator returns buckets sorted by descending count.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g. CA, NY, TX, FL). Case-insensitive on input; normalized to uppercase. DC is accepted. Full state names like 'California' are not accepted - use 'CA' instead.

name: clinicaltrials_list_top_conditions

conditions.description: Conditions sorted by descending trial count.

count.description: Number of active US trials tagged with this condition in the scope.

name.description: Condition label as recorded in AACT conditions.name.

slug.description: Curated condition slug to use as a search filter, or null when this label has no curated match.

scope.description: Echo of the resolved scope so the caller can confirm what the server interpreted.

city.description: Canonical city name resolved from the slug, present when city scope was used.

state.description: Canonical state code applied to this search.

title: List Top Conditions
